acceptance_gate.condition: grounding_auroc_real_corpus present AND confidence_baseline_auroc present AND positive_control_valid == true AND grounding_leak_free == true
acceptance_gate.principle: A corrected facts verdict requires the real verifier fired leak-free on a headroom-bearing real corpus vs a measured confidence baseline -- otherwise it repeats the synthetic-corpus limitation.

field_principles.confidence_baseline_auroc: The bar (from exp3669); facts AUROC-value requires beating it.
field_principles.facts_conditional_catch_rate: Errors grounding catches that confidence misses at fixed FPR -- the second-pair-of-eyes lens AUROC hides.
field_principles.facts_generalize_or_adds_value_real: BARE bool. True iff on the REAL corpus grounding materially beats confidence in AUROC OR adds significant complementary catch-value (McNemar p<0.05 with positive catch-rate), leak-free -- the corrected core-mission answer. STORE AS BARE true/false.
field_principles.grounding_auroc_real_corpus: The real NLI grounding signal on the REAL corpus + CI -- the corrected facts-row number.
field_principles.grounding_leak_free: True iff evidence excludes the gold answer AND AUROC < 0.99 AND the label is never read.
field_principles.grounding_minus_confidence_delta: Signed paired delta + CI -- additive facts value over confidence in AUROC terms.
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: scores the cached real corpus; no LLM load).
field_principles.mcnemar_p_facts: Paired significance of the grounding-vs-confidence disagreement on real data.
field_principles.positive_control_valid: True iff the verifier fired leak-free on a headroom-bearing real corpus (confidence < 0.95) -- a null without this is uninformative.
field_principles.real_vs_synthetic_grounding_delta: Did using a REAL corpus change the .335 synthetic answer (grounding 0.744)? -- the corpus-artifact question.

inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: scores the cached real corpus; no LLM load).
